scope: Unary, per-realization deterministic invariants for corpus candidate and FLEXPART 11.1 oracle artifacts, plus one ensemble-level exact-repeat invariant. The #51 case manifest decides whether a process or output is declared; this contract decides how the declared values are checked. Invariants never establish input equivalence (#52), execution provenance (#53) or candidate/oracle parity (#55-#59).

verdicts.PASS: The invariant applies, all required evidence is present and verified, and the assertion holds.
verdicts.FAIL: The invariant applies, the evidence is usable, and the observed value violates the assertion.
verdicts.INTEGRITY_ERROR: Required evidence or metadata is malformed, corrupt, contradictory, hash-mismatched, non-finite, negative where the v1 positivity contract forbids it, or attributed to the wrong execution. No scientific statement is made.
verdicts.NOT_APPLICABLE: The validated case manifest explicitly establishes that the invariant does not apply. Missing data is never NOT_APPLICABLE.
verdicts.BLOCKED: The invariant applies or may apply, but required scientific evidence or a supported evaluation capability is unavailable. Never a PASS.

aggregation.rule: The aggregate is the highest-precedence verdict over every record of every realization and every ensemble-level record. Records are never averaged, weighted or filtered; every FAIL, INTEGRITY_ERROR and BLOCKED identifier is listed explicitly next to the aggregate so no individual failure can be hidden by passing records or realizations. Consistent with the #52 input-equivalence precedence (integrity before mismatch before not-demonstrated).

invariants.meaning: Every declared mass and concentration value (particle masses, mass reservoirs, gridded concentration and deposition cells) is a finite number with the declared array shape.
required_artifacts: candidate seed_*.json particle masses and reservoirs
candidate gridded concentration
oracle header + every grid_conc_* concentration, wet and dry block
invariants.normalization: none; every cell of every field is evaluated, offenders are listed by field and cell index
invariants.pass: All values finite and every field has the declared cell count.
invariants.fail: Not used: a non-finite or malformed field is an integrity error under the established evaluator contract.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED when the realization carries no mass or concentration values.
invariants.integrity_error: NONFINITE_VALUE for NaN/+Inf/-Inf; MALFORMED_FIELD for non-numeric entries or a cell count that contradicts the declared shape.

invariants.meaning: Every declared mass and concentration value is non-negative. No negative residual epsilon is permitted; values are never clamped.
required_artifacts: same field set as INV-FIELD-FINITE
invariants.fail: Not used: scientific-thresholds v1 MASS_POSITIVITY classifies every negative mass or concentration as an integrity error, not a scientific result.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED when the realization carries no mass or concentration values.
invariants.integrity_error: NEGATIVE_VALUE with field and cell identifiers; UPSTREAM_FIELD_INTEGRITY when the field is already non-finite or malformed.

invariants.meaning: Released mass equals airborne mass plus every reservoir of a process the case enables (dry deposition, wet deposition, decay). Disabled processes contribute no term. Forward simulations only.
required_artifacts: #51 case release.inventory.quantity_kg
candidate particle masses, particle_count, active_particles
deposited_dry_kg / deposited_wet_kg / decayed_kg for each enabled process
oracle: a kilogram mass ledger (not produced by FLEXPART 11.1 binary output)
invariants.normalization: relative residual (airborne + enabled reservoirs - released) / released, computed by scripts/evaluate/metrics.py::mass_budget
invariants.fail: MASS_DEFICIT (silent mass disappearance) or MASS_EXCESS (double counting or mass creation).
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED: MISSING_RESERVOIR for an enabled process without a ledger, MISSING_TERMINATION_RESERVOIR when particles were deactivated without a termination ledger, PARTICLE_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE without particle counts, MASS_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE for oracle runs without a kilogram ledger, CASE_MANIFEST_UNAVAILABLE without a #51 case.
invariants.integrity_error: UPSTREAM_FIELD_INTEGRITY when a consumed field failed INV-FIELD-*; INITIAL_MASS_CONTRADICTS_CASE when the artifact's declared initial mass differs from the case inventory by more than MASS_BUDGET_CLOSE.

invariants.meaning: A case that disables dry deposition produces no dry-deposited mass.
required_artifacts: candidate deposited_dry_kg (corpus-run output contract: zero when dry deposition is off)
oracle grid_conc_* dry-deposition sparse block (FLEXPART writes the block with zero entries when DRYDEP is off)
invariants.pass: The ledger is exactly 0.0 (every oracle cell exactly 0.0). Without a ledger, the closure deficit of INV-MASS-CLOSURE (whose identity omits the disabled term) bounds any removal and PASS requires that closure did not report MASS_DEFICIT.
invariants.fail: DISABLED_PROCESS_NONZERO_RESERVOIR for any non-zero ledger value; UNEXPLAINED_MASS_LOSS when the closure bound reports a deficit.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (CLOSURE_UNAVAILABLE) without a ledger and without an evaluated closure. Absence of a field is never read as zero.
invariants.integrity_error: UPSTREAM_FIELD_INTEGRITY when the ledger or closure inputs failed INV-FIELD-*.

invariants.meaning: A case that disables wet deposition produces no wet-deposited mass.
required_artifacts: candidate deposited_wet_kg
oracle grid_conc_* wet-deposition sparse block
invariants.pass: As INV-DISABLED-DRY-DEPOSITION-ZERO for the wet ledger.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (CLOSURE_UNAVAILABLE) without a ledger and without an evaluated closure.

invariants.meaning: A case that disables decay loses no mass to decay. This is the deterministic decay control for every current corpus case.
required_artifacts: decayed_kg when the artifact carries a decay ledger (corpus-run does not); otherwise the INV-MASS-CLOSURE residual
invariants.pass: decayed_kg is exactly 0.0, or (without a decay ledger) INV-MASS-CLOSURE did not report MASS_DEFICIT: decay can only remove mass, so any decay loss appears as a closure deficit bounded by MASS_BUDGET_CLOSE.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (CLOSURE_UNAVAILABLE) for oracle runs without a kilogram ledger and for candidate runs whose closure is blocked.

invariants.meaning: Without turbulence, convection, deposition or decay, a point release in a uniform wind field is displaced by exactly (u, v, w) * elapsed time; every particle is checked, so no spread is allowed either.
required_artifacts: #51 case release point, wind u/v/w, integration start/total_s
particle end positions (candidate seed file; oracle partposit dump, NetCDF-only in FLEXPART 11.1 and therefore normally absent)
invariants.normalization: Geographic degrees are converted at the release latitude with R = 6371000 m (metrics.EARTH_RADIUS_M, identical to the Rust grid scale); the expectation comes only from the case manifest, never from candidate output.
invariants.pass: Every particle's displacement residual is within the corpus analytic_advection_* bound for each component.
invariants.fail: ANALYTIC_DISPLACEMENT_EXCEEDED with the worst particle index, component, actual, expected and residual.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED: PARTICLE_POSITIONS_UNAVAILABLE without end positions; NO_VERSIONED_THRESHOLD when the case qualifies but lies outside the threshold's justified scope (the corpus bounds are calibrated as 1% of the 36000 m ADV-ANA-001 signal).

invariants.meaning: With decay enabled, remaining and decayed mass follow the pinned FLEXPART exponential decay of the declared species half-life.
required_artifacts: decay ledger in the artifact
species half-life bound by the #51 species physics contract
versioned decay comparison threshold owned by the decay issue
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (DECAY_SEMANTICS_UNAVAILABLE): no species contract binds a half-life, corpus-run writes no decay ledger and no decay threshold is versioned; DECAY-011 owns the follow-up.

invariants.meaning: Realizations that reuse one declared Philox identity (derivation reuse_base_identity_v1, e.g. REPEAT-009) produce bit-identical particle states and reservoirs.
required_artifacts: all candidate seed files of the case

comparison.reference: fixtures/corpus/corpus.json REPEAT-009 thresholds: exact equality for candidate rerun

invariants.pass: Every realization equals the first realization exactly.
invariants.fail: REPEAT_NOT_IDENTICAL with the first differing realization, particle and component.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (INSUFFICIENT_REPEATS) with fewer than two realizations.
invariants.integrity_error: UPSTREAM_FIELD_INTEGRITY when a realization failed INV-FIELD-*.

invariants.meaning: Every consumed artifact belongs to the case manifest being evaluated.
required_artifacts: embedded case_id (candidate) or v1 run-manifest execution case binding (oracle)
invariants.pass: Artifact case id equals the manifest case id.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (CASE_MANIFEST_UNAVAILABLE or PROVENANCE_MISSING) when neither the artifact nor a run manifest binds a case id.

invariants.meaning: The case declares the units the evaluator consumes: mass and inventory in kg, concentration in kg/m3 for the time-averaged mass-concentration output.
required_artifacts: #51 case units, release.inventory.unit, output.quantity
invariants.pass: Every declared unit matches the consumed unit.
invariants.integrity_error: UNIT_MISMATCH; no unit conversion is inferred.

invariants.meaning: Particle ledgers are self-consistent: emitted records equal active_particles, active_particles <= particle_count, and particle_count equals the case release.particle_count.
required_artifacts: candidate seed file particle_count, active_particles, particles
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED (PARTICLE_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE or GRIDDED_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE for gridded-only realizations).

invariants.meaning: Gridded output uses exactly the case output_grid (shape, origin, spacing, layer heights) within report.GRID_ABS_TOL; nothing is regridded.
required_artifacts: oracle header
candidate gridded output (corpus seed files carry none)

invariants.meaning: Gridded output follows the case chronology: start equals integration.start, averaging/sampling/interval equal the case output block, and output timestamps are exactly start + k * interval_s up to the simulation end (forward direction).
required_artifacts: oracle header (ibdate/ibtime, loutstep/loutaver/loutsample) and grid_conc_* timestamps
candidate gridded output windows
invariants.pass: All chronology fields and the timestamp sequence match exactly.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED: GRIDDED_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE for particle-only realizations; DIRECTION_UNSUPPORTED for backward cases (no evaluator capability yet).

invariants.meaning: Every artifact of the realization is hash-verified by the #53 v1 run manifest and bound to exactly one execution of the matching role, case manifest and realization.
required_artifacts: --run-manifest (v1, verified by scripts/provenance/run_provenance.py)
invariants.pass: All artifacts verified and bound to one execution whose case_id, case_manifest_sha256 and realization agree.
invariants.missing_evidence: BLOCKED: PROVENANCE_MISSING without a manifest, EXECUTION_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE for legacy manifests, ARTIFACT_NOT_COVERED for uncovered artifacts.
invariants.integrity_error: PROVENANCE_INVALID (hash mismatch, stale run, mixed revisions/builds, INVALID manifest), EXECUTION_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS, EXECUTION_BINDING_MISMATCH.

states.NOT_REQUESTED: No oracle artifact was supplied; candidate-only unary evaluation.
states.BLOCKED: An oracle artifact was supplied without --require-input-equivalence; INPUT_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED stays in force.
states.ELIGIBLE: The #52 report is INPUT_EQUIVALENT for this case. Paired scoring may proceed only after #53 attribution; eligibility is not parity.

paired_scoring.rule: Unary invariants never manufacture input equivalence. A requested gate that refuses scoring is an INTEGRITY_ERROR with error id INPUT_MISMATCH, INPUT_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED or INPUT_EQUIVALENCE_INTEGRITY_ERROR.

downstream_handoff.contract: Consumers read report['deterministic_invariants'] and must call invariants.aggregate_realizations (or apply aggregation.precedence) over every realization record. A deterministic FAIL, INTEGRITY_ERROR or BLOCKED is never overridden by stochastic agreement, averaging or favorable aggregate statistics; distributional scoring may run only when the aggregate is PASS and paired_scoring.status is ELIGIBLE.

change_policy: Any change to an invariant's meaning, applicability, comparison policy or threshold binding requires a new invariant version and a new contract file. Thresholds are referenced, never copied: their values are read from the threshold sources at evaluation time.
